citations.quote: My mother is 84 and has arthritis; she says the pain in her hips has got much worse since her room became cold, and I can see that she is struggling more.
Two of the four radiators in the flat stay cold even when fully open, so the living room and my mother's room never get properly warm.
I want to make it clear that I intend to pay the rent into the official rent deposit instead of to Domicil Plus if the radiators are not fixed.
I wish to report a defect in my flat: two of the four radiators stay cold even when they are turned up fully. The living room and the second bedroom therefore cannot be heated.
I ask you to have the heating repaired as soon as possible.

plan.because: Needed to establish the parties, property and tenancy terms.
The supplied letter describes the defect but is undated. Request dated notice evidence.
Evidence of when the landlord received the report is missing.
Dated objective evidence of the affected radiators and rooms is missing.
The landlord's response, proposed work and access arrangements are not documented.
Mould is not mentioned and is presumed absent for the evidence plan.
The heating branch is active; request any inspection or service findings.
Health effects are reported; confirmation should document findings without assuming the cause.
A need for a specialist is not mentioned and is presumed absent for the evidence plan; causation remains open.
The deposit route is contemplated. The supplied letter asks for repair as soon as possible but contains no specific repair deadline.
This document is optional under the process.

questions: Is your mother's room currently safe and warm enough? If her health is worsening or she cannot keep warm, please seek prompt medical or emergency assistance as appropriate.
When was the attached letter sent, and do you have proof of its delivery or receipt?
What has the landlord said or done, and has any inspection, repair or access appointment been arranged?
Has a heating technician inspected the radiators, and is a report available?
Have you sent a separate written repair deadline? If so, please provide it and evidence of delivery.
